subject.title: fix(auth): allow OpenAI OAuth for audio transcription

question: Should OpenClaw officially support ChatGPT/Codex OAuth for native OpenAI Platform `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, despite the documented Platform API-key contract?
rationale: The patch is a deliberate provider-auth capability expansion, not a mechanical restoration of a documented current contract; only maintainers can decide whether this OAuth route is a supported OpenClaw product promise and documentation obligation.

options.title: Adopt native OAuth STT support
options.body: Accept OAuth only for the tightly validated native OpenAI audio endpoint, add provider documentation for credential precedence and endpoint limits, and require fresh redacted live proof on the final head.

options.title: Keep Platform API-key-only audio
options.body: Retain the current documented API-key contract for batch audio transcription and close this PR as an unsupported alternative auth route.

recommendation.title: Adopt native OAuth STT support
recommendation.body: Accept OAuth only for the tightly validated native OpenAI audio endpoint, add provider documentation for credential precedence and endpoint limits, and require fresh redacted live proof on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged audio-auth work is the immediate current-main contract this PR changes.
